checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: All clutter on counters, sink and stove removed.

must.item: Brown cabinets and beige tiles remain

must.why: Sink, faucet, stove, window, outlets all in place; the right-hand stove burners are now plain.
Counters look clean and seamless; the left counter edge is slightly smoothed, and the stove looks slightly simplified.

faults.what: Stove top is smoothed and slightly simplified into two dark burner pans, with the knob/detail lost.
Counter edge strips and the backsplash edge are slightly more uniform than in the source.

summary: The edit cleared all counter, sink and stove clutter cleanly while keeping the cabinets, tiles, layout and framing intact, with only minor smoothing of the stove."
